text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt satisfying, but the later buybacks at higher prices remind me not to sell just to lock in gains; I should use a portfolio-based plan.","My account grew during several periods with no trades, so frequent checking and trading are not reasons to act; I should avoid unnecessary turnover.","I should judge risk across the whole portfolio, not each stock by its gain or loss versus my cost, and remember that random past price moves do not predict what comes next."]}
